sources.title: On congruence subgroups of SL_2(Z[1/p]) generated by two parabolic elements
sources.version: arXiv:2312.11258v2, 2024-01-30; version notes correct a gap in Theorem 4.2
sources.relevance: Primary context for two-parabolic groups and congruence conditions; the project's finite-ring closure lemma is proved separately and does not use this paper's conjectures about SL_2(Z[1/p]).
